# uFTi user manual: Windows

> Understanding family tree information

## Quick Start

- [Quick Start](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/quick-start/quick-start.html): Six short pages that take you from opening uFTi to your first person, with its source and a copy.
- [Look around](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/look-around.html): Open uFTi and find the main places: the menu at the left, the plus button, search and Help.
- [Add your first person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-your-first-person.html): Make a tree of your own and add the first person to it.
- [Say where you found it](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/say-where-you-found-it.html): Add a source to a fact, so you always know why you believe it.
- [Keep it safe](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/keep-it-safe.html): Save a copy of your tree as a file, and keep it somewhere else too.
- [What next](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/quick-start/what-next.html): You have a tree, a person, a fact with its source and a copy, so choose where to go from here.

## Contents

- [Five things to know](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/quick-start/five-things-to-know.html): The five ideas behind uFTi, in two minutes.

## Work with your tree

- [Work with your tree](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/work-with-your-tree.html): Find people, add people and families, read their events and sources, and write notes.
- [The screens of the app](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/tour-of-the-screens.html): What each item in the menu shows, what the top of every screen holds, and a picture of the main screens.
- [Find a person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/find-a-person.html): Search your tree by a name, a place or an event, then open the person you want.
- [See a family tree](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/see-a-family-tree.html): Draw the parents, partners and children of one person, and read the drawing.
- [See the events of a person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/see-the-events-of-a-person.html): List what happened in a person's life, such as birth, baptism and death, and open any one.
- [Dates](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/dates.html): How uFTi records a date, from one you know in full to one you only know in part.
- [The kinds of date](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/kinds-of-date.html): Seven ways to say how sure you are of a date, each with an example.
- [Typing a date](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/typing-a-date.html): What uFTi reads when you type a date in one box, and what it keeps exactly as you typed it.
- [Calendars and old dates](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/calendars.html): The four calendars uFTi keeps, and what you need to know when a record is from before 1752.
- [A worked case: a birth in January](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/an-old-style-date.html): How a year that began in March can change a birth year, shown with a diarist born in 1671.
- [A worked case: two calendars in one life](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/two-calendars-one-life.html): How far apart the Julian and Gregorian calendars were in the life of a diarist who lived from 1671 to 1704.
- [Dates in lists and in order](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/dates-in-lists-and-order.html): Where you can enter a date, how uFTi shows it, how it puts dates in order and what it checks.
- [Places](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/places.html): How uFTi records a place, and how it helps you spell a place the same way each time.
- [Names](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/tree/names.html): What uFTi does when you save a person whose name is already in the tree, and how to choose.
- [Look at the sources of a fact](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/look-at-the-sources-of-a-fact.html): See which books and records are listed for a birth, a death or another fact, and add one.
- [Add another person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-another-person.html): Add a person to a tree that already has someone in it.
- [Change a person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/change-a-person.html): Correct a name, a date or a place on a person's page.
- [Remove a person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/remove-a-person.html): Remove a person from your tree, for example one you added by mistake.
- [Add a family with children](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-a-family.html): Join two partners who are already in the tree, and add their children.
- [Add a later family](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-a-later-family.html): Make a family for a person who is already in the tree, such as a daughter who marries.
- [See a family's page](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/see-a-familys-page.html): Read the page of a family, and add the marriage to it.
- [Add a note to a person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-a-note.html): Write down something you know about a person that does not fit in a date or a place.
- [Choose how the app looks](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/choose-how-it-looks.html): Pick a colour theme, and a light or dark look, for this computer.
- [Find help and the version](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/find-help-and-the-version.html): Find the Help button on a screen, and read which version of the app you have.
- [A page says no person is selected](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/a-page-says-no-person-selected.html): What to do when Person, Family tree or Events have nobody to show.

## Events, notes and sources

- [Events, notes and sources](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/events-notes-and-sources.html): Record what happened in a life, write down what you know, and say where you found it.
- [Add an event to a person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-an-event.html): Record something that happened in a person's life, such as a baptism, with its date and place.
- [Enter a period](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/enter-a-period.html): Record something that lasted for years, such as a home, by typing both dates in one box.
- [Add an event of your own kind](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-an-event-of-your-own-kind.html): Record something that has no word in the list of events, such as the publication of a book, by naming the kind yourself.
- [Use one note for several people](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/use-one-note-for-several-people.html): Write a note once, then use the same note on the page of another person.
- [Add a repository](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-a-repository.html): Record an archive, a library or a museum that keeps the records you use, so a source can point to it.
- [Add a source to a person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-a-source.html): Describe a book, a register or a web page you used, so that someone else could find it again.
- [Add a research note](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-a-research-note.html): Write down a question you are trying to answer, with a status, and tie it to the people it is about.
- [Record a search that found nothing](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/record-a-search-that-found-nothing.html): Write down where you looked and what came back, so that you, or someone else, never has to look there again.
- [Use a form for a real record](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/use-a-form-for-a-real-record.html): Choose the form that matches a record you have, such as the 1841 census, and see what it fills in for you.

## Bring in, share and keep safe

- [Bring in, share and keep safe](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/workspaces/bring-in-share-and-keep-safe.html): What your workspace holds, why a GEDZIP file is the one to keep and send, and when a plain family tree file is better.
- [Create a workspace](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/create-a-workspace.html): Start a new, empty family tree and give it a name.
- [Say who made this tree](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/say-who-made-this-tree.html): Add your name, or the name of a group, as the maker of your tree.
- [Move between workspaces](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/move-between-workspaces.html): Open another of your trees, and see which one is open now.
- [Your workspace and its files](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/topics/workspaces/your-workspace-and-its-files.html): A workspace is your family tree and its linked files, and a GEDZIP file holds all of them in one file.
- [Where your trees are saved](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/where-your-trees-are-saved.html): New trees are saved in a folder named uFTi inside your Documents folder, and they stay there if you remove the app.
- [Opened files and copies](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/opened-files-and-copies.html): On Windows, uFTi works on the file you open, so make a copy first if you want the original left alone.
- [Open a family tree file](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/open-a-family-tree-file.html): Bring a tree from another program, or a copy from a relative, into uFTi.
- [Remove a tree from the list](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/remove-a-workspace.html): Take a tree off the Workspaces page without deleting its file.
- [Which file to send](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/desktop/topics/which-file-to-send.html): Send a GEDZIP file to anyone who uses uFTi, and a plain family tree file only to an older program.
- [Files beside your tree](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/desktop/topics/files-beside-your-tree.html): The files you may see beside your tree: the tree itself and its backup.
- [Add a photo to a person](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/add-a-photo.html): Choose a photo or a scan from your PC for a person's page.
- [The Photos buttons](https://docs.ufti.com/windows/Alpha-2/platforms/windows/topics/the-photos-buttons.html): What the buttons in the Photos part of a person's page are for.
